                    (SELECT count(*) FROM org WHERE dept IN ('16', '17', '19', '23', '24', '33', '40', '47', '64', '79', '86', '87'))::int AS "naOrganizations",
                    (SELECT count(*) FROM source)::int AS sources,
                    (SELECT count(*) FROM event)::int AS events
